title: edf-buffered-write: a buffer-then-flush EDF/EDF+ writer and a round-trip integrity test

creators.name: Agis-Torres, Ángel
creators.affiliation: Department of Physiology (Faculty of Pharmacy), Universidad Complutense de Madrid

description:
An open-source Python library and reproducibility package accompanying the manuscript Silent corruption of European Data Format recordings during real-time biopotential streaming: a buffered-write solution (submitted).

When real-time acquisition software writes sub-record device blocks straight to an incremental EDF writer, each write commits a full data record padded to length: the resulting EDF+ file is structurally valid yet inflated by the record-to-block ratio, with attenuated RMS amplitude and a distorted power spectrum, and no error is raised. The package provides two remedies: a reusable buffer-then-flush writer (edf_buffered_write.BufferedEdfWriter) that commits only complete records, and a library-independent round-trip integrity test that compares reported duration, RMS amplitude and power spectral density. It also bundles the characterisation harness (a configuration sweep and a comparison of three EDF writers: pyedflib and EDFlib-Python, both built on van Beelen's EDFlib, and the independent edfio) and reproduces the failure and its remedy on two real surface-EMG recordings acquired with independent hardware chains (a BITalino board and an Arduino-compatible board with a MyoWare 2.0 sensor), included here as de-identified EDF+ files.
